title: Balance Transfer Terms by Tier, Personal Credit Cards
content:
1. A balance transfer moves a balance held with another lender onto a Piedmont Crescent Bank card. Whether a tier of Personal Credit Cards accepts balance transfers at all is a term of the tier.

2. Where a tier offers an introductory balance transfer rate, that rate runs for a stated number of statement cycles after opening and is earned only by a transfer that posts within a stated number of calendar days after opening.

3. The transfer fee is quoted as a percentage of each transfer with a floor in dollars per transfer.

| Tier | Transfers accepted | Introductory rate | Introductory cycles after opening | Days after opening to post | Fee percentage | Smallest fee per transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | no | not offered | not offered | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| College Rewards Visa | no | not offered | not offered | not offered | not applicable | not applicable |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | yes | 0.0 percent | 18 | 60 | 3.0 percent | 5.00 USD |
| Cash Rewards Visa | yes | 0.0 percent | 15 | 60 | 3.0 percent | 5.00 USD |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | yes | not offered | not offered | not offered | 5.0 percent | 5.00 USD |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | yes | not offered | not offered | not offered | 5.0 percent | 5.00 USD |

4. Two tiers of the six accept no transfer at all. Of the four that do, Platinum Low Rate Visa and Cash Rewards Visa are the two that offer an introductory rate of 0.0 percent, differing only in its length: 18 cycles against 15. Both allow 60 calendar days after opening for the transfer to post. The two tiers with no introductory offer, Travel Rewards Visa Signature and Visa Infinite Private Client, charge the higher fee percentage, 5.0 percent against 3.0 percent, while all four share the floor of 5.00 USD per transfer.
